summary.text: Dementia does not automatically qualify someone for CareShield Life claims. A severe disability assessment is still needed.

details.heading: Why an assessment is needed
details.body: Dementia or other cognitive impairments can affect a person’s functional abilities to different extents. This is why an assessment is still required.

example_phrasings: Does an individual with dementia automatically qualify for CareShield Life claims?
Can someone with dementia claim CareShield Life automatically?
Does dementia mean I can get CareShield Life payouts?

sources.page_title: Does an individual with dementia automatically qualify for CareShield Life claims?

quotes.text: Applicants with dementia or other cognitive impairments will not automatically qualify for CareShield Life/ElderShield claims and will still need to undergo a severe disability assessment
as dementia/cognitive impairment could affect the applicant’s functional abilities to varying extents.
